About PhonePe

PhonePe is India's leading digital payments platform with 500 million registered users and 37% UPI market share. We're India's largest fintech company by transaction volume and are rapidly expanding into financial services: insurance, investments, lending, and commerce. We're building the financial super-app for India.

About the Role

Product Manager for PhonePe's Core UPI Payments experience. This is one of the highest-stakes PM roles in Indian tech — you'll own the default payment flow that 500 million people use. Your decisions affect every PhonePe transaction in India. You'll focus on improving activation, engagement, and reliability of the core payments product.

Responsibilities

• Own the product roadmap for PhonePe's core UPI payment flows
• Define and track key metrics: activation rates, success rates, DAU/MAU, repeat transaction frequency
• Conduct user research to understand payment behavior across diverse Indian user segments
• Work with engineering, design, and data science to ship improvements rapidly
• Define and run rigorous A/B experiments; make data-driven decisions
• Collaborate with NPCI and banking partners on new UPI feature rollouts
• Identify and drive growth levers: new use cases, merchant onboarding, feature discovery

Minimum Qualifications

• 3+ years of product management experience at a consumer internet company
• Strong analytical skills: ability to write SQL queries, analyze dashboards, and draw insights
• Experience designing and running A/B experiments
• Ability to write clear, detailed PRDs and influence engineering without direct authority
• Strong communication skills and stakeholder management experience

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in fintech, payments, or financial services
• Understanding of UPI, NEFT, IMPS infrastructure
• Familiarity with behavioral economics and engagement design
• Experience managing products at 100M+ user scale
• MBA from a tier-1 institution

What We Offer

ESOPs with significant upside, competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and the unmatched opportunity to shape how 500 million Indians interact with money every day.

About Atlassian

Atlassian powers the teams behind some of the world's greatest products — from NASA to Netflix. Our tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello, Bitbucket) are used by 300,000+ companies globally. We believe in teamwork, transparency, and the power of software teams to change the world.

About the Role

Senior Product Manager for Jira's Enterprise tier. You'll own the product experience for our largest customers — Fortune 500 companies with complex organizational hierarchies, security requirements, and integration needs. Your work will directly affect Atlassian's most valuable customer segment.

Responsibilities

• Define the 12-18 month product roadmap for Jira Enterprise, aligned with company strategy
• Partner with Enterprise Sales and Customer Success to deeply understand enterprise pain points
• Own key enterprise metrics: contract expansion, NPS, feature adoption, and churn prevention
• Work with engineering teams across 3 time zones to deliver complex features
• Build compelling business cases for roadmap investments with quantified ROI
• Engage directly with enterprise customers through EBRs, beta programs, and advisory boards
• Define and track OKRs; report progress to senior leadership

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of B2B product management experience
• Deep understanding of enterprise software buying processes and procurement
• Experience with product-led growth (PLG) motions in SaaS
• Strong data analysis skills and familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, LTV)
• Ability to influence across functions without direct authority
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience at a developer tools or collaboration software company
• Familiarity with Jira/Confluence as a user or admin
• Experience managing products for technical personas (engineers, PMs, DevOps)
• Background in agile software development
• MBA from a top institution

What We Offer

Atlassian offers distributed-first work, equity, 5 weeks PTO, learning budget, and a culture that genuinely values work-life balance.

About Meesho

Meesho is India's fastest-growing e-commerce platform, built for the next billion internet users. We enable millions of entrepreneurs — primarily women from Tier 2 and Tier 3 India — to build businesses by reselling products through WhatsApp and social media. We're building for India's heartland, not just its metros.

About the Role

Growth PM for Meesho's New Supplier Acquisition and Activation team. India has 70 million MSMEs, and we've onboarded less than 2%. You'll own the full funnel from supplier awareness to first successful sale — building growth loops that help India's small businesses reach millions of customers.

Responsibilities

• Own the new supplier acquisition funnel: from first touch to GMV-generating supplier
• Define and optimize activation metrics: time-to-first-listing, time-to-first-order, 30-day retention
• Design and run growth experiments: referral programs, onboarding nudges, gamification
• Use cohort analysis to identify drop-off points and root cause them
• Build supplier segmentation models to personalize onboarding journeys
• Collaborate with business development to create growth playbooks for new geographies
• Define push notification and CRM communication strategies

Minimum Qualifications

• 2+ years of growth product management experience
• Strong SQL skills for funnel analysis and cohort segmentation
• Experience with A/B testing and statistical significance
• Understanding of growth frameworks: AARRR, referral loops, viral coefficients
• Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building products for Bharat (Tier 2/3 cities, vernacular users)
• Prior experience with B2B2C marketplace models
• Familiarity with CRM/marketing automation tools (MoEngage, CleverTap)
• Experience with ML-based personalization

What We Offer

ESOPs, competitive compensation, flexible work, and the rare opportunity to build products that create economic opportunities for millions of Indian entrepreneurs.
